1.0.2: FindEvents uses paging to get all 250 events matching the query.
1.1.2: Create Event now only shows the calendars to which the user has write access to.
1.1.3: UpdateEvent: fixed error 'required property Calendar' when the value to field Calendar was mapped from different component.
1.2.0: Add GetAvailability component to check for free/busy time in a calendar.
1.3.0: Add DeclineEvent component to decline calendar event invitations.
1.4.0: EventStart, NewCalendar, NewEvent: added test() method for Flow Test Mode (read-only fetch of the newest matching event/calendar).
1.5.0: Added MakeApiCall component for performing arbitrary authorized API calls to the Google Calendar API.
1.6.0: Add AcceptEvent action to accept a calendar event invitation.
Add UpdatedEvent trigger that fires when an existing event changes.
Add DeletedEvent trigger that fires when an event is deleted.
Validate required inputs (throw a clear error when a required field is missing) in CreateCalendar, CreateEvent, DeclineEvent, DeleteCalendar, DeleteEvent, FindEvent, GetAvailability and UpdateEvent.

Changed the dynamic Calendar/Event picker inputs to free-text fields so an ID mapped from a previous step is accepted (EventStart, ListEvents, NewEvent, AcceptEvent, DeclineEvent, DeleteEvent, UpdateEvent).
